findings.observed: `aws_s3_bucket.logs` will be destroyed because it left the configuration, and `aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs` will be created with the same `bucket` ("fixture-alb-access-logs-eu-west-2"). A shared identity suggests a possible address rename; it does not establish that these are the same cloud object. The S3 bucket would be destroyed with it, losing every object and object version in the bucket.
findings.recommendation: Confirm that both entries refer to the same provider configuration, account, region and cloud object before considering a moved block (`from = aws_s3_bucket.logs`, `to = aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs`). Otherwise review the intended migration and any uniqueness constraints on bucket.
findings.title: `aws_s3_bucket.logs` and `aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs` share an identity across a destroy/create pair: possible address rename

findings.observed: The S3 bucket versioning is destroyed because it is no longer in the configuration.
findings.recommendation: Confirm nothing outside this configuration still depends on it.
